example.title: Palomar Apartment Building
example.place: San Diego, San Diego County, CA

brief: A 1980s-remodelled three-storey Spanish-revival apartment building: ochre stucco, red-tile roof edges and tiled chimney caps, iron balconettes, bougainvillea at the arched entrance. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
